tool.archive_digest_binding: Official GitHub release API, then downloaded bytes checked locally and again in isolated build container

build_script:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,tarfile
archive=Path("/work/build-tools/cargo-auditable-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.xz")
expected="bcb2d46002a8dd8e94d0d669cb39d38c9651db2ae5d1f3f1f1bab516ee1e212c"
assert hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected
with tarfile.open(archive) as package:
    members=[m for m in package.getmembers() if m.isfile() and Path(m.name).name=="cargo-auditable"]
    assert len(members)==1
    raw=package.extractfile(members[0]).read()
tool=Path("/work/build-tools/cargo-auditable")
tool.write_bytes(raw);tool.chmod(0o700)
print(json.dumps({"tool":"cargo-auditable","version":"0.7.7","archive_sha256":expected,"executable_sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}),flush=True)
os.environ["PATH"]=str(tool.parent)+":"+os.environ["PATH"]
raise SystemExit(subprocess.call(["cargo","auditable","build","--release","--locked","--offline","-p","sparkdev-link"]))
